body.message:
This is not my fault. Your balcony was already dirty and covered in black dust when we arrived. Every time we went onto the balcony and came back inside, it left black marks on the floor and the rug. We noticed this on the very first day and stopped using the balcony afterwards.

It is not our responsibility that the balcony was not cleaned before our arrival. I even informed your colleague about this from the beginning and sent a message. You only need to check our previous conversation to verify it.

Please return my security deposit. Do not look for an excuse to keep it. The apartment was left clean, nothing was damaged, and you have no valid reason to withhold my deposit.

If necessary, I will come to your office in person because I have proof that everything was clean when we left. A Peninsula security guard inspected the apartment and took photos before our departure.
